gloss: to wrap up; to round up; to raise (prices)

definitions.gloss: to wrap up; to finish early; to call it a day
definitions.explanation: To end an activity, meeting, or work earlier than originally planned or scheduled.
In mathematics, to round a decimal number up to the nearest integer or specified decimal place.
To increase prices, values, or standards.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{早|はや}めに{仕事|しごと}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げよう。
examples.english: Let's wrap up work early today.

examples.japanese: {小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}は{切|き}り{上|あ}げてください。
examples.english: Please round up the decimal places.

examples.japanese: {定価|ていか}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げることになった。
examples.english: It was decided to raise the list price.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{切|き}り{上|あ}げる → {切|き}り{上|あ}げない (negative)
・{切|き}り{上|あ}げる → {切|き}り{上|あ}げて (te-form)
・{切|き}り{上|あ}げる → {切|き}り{上|あ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {切|き}る (to cut) + {上|あ}げる (up)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{会議|かいぎ}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げる - to wrap up a meeting
・{飲|の}み{会|かい}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げる - to leave a drinking party early
・{端数|はすう}を{切|き}り{上|あ}げる - to round up fractions

ANTONYM:
・{切|き}り{下|さ}げる - to round down; to lower
